### Planner Response

### Root cause from your latest logs/flow
The remaining issue was in the **Settings edit-existing photo-square path** (not the new/add path).  
[UnifiedBackgroundEditor](file:///c:/Users/javie/AndroidStudioProjects/TeXter2025/app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/UnifiedBackgroundEditor.kt:23:0-538:1) rotation changes were not being routed back in that edit branch, so offset/scale updated, but rotation could stay stale downstream.

### Fix applied
In [SettingsScreen](file:///c:/Users/javie/AndroidStudioProjects/TeXter2025/app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/SettingsScreen.kt:150:0-830:1) edit dialog wiring, I added the missing rotation callback path:

- Added `onPhotoRotationChange = { ... }` in the edit [UnifiedBackgroundEditor(...)](file:///c:/Users/javie/AndroidStudioProjects/TeXter2025/app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/UnifiedBackgroundEditor.kt:23:0-538:1) call
- Routed by section:
  - `content` -> `onContentAreaPhotoRotationChange`
  - `memo` -> `onMemoAreaPhotoRotationChange`
  - `fileListItem` -> `onFileListItemPhotoRotationChange`
  - `fileListBg` -> `onFileListBgPhotoRotationChange`
  - default/background -> `onBackgroundPhotoRotationChange`
- Synced `presetToEdit.photoRotation` and `onEditCustomColor(...)` payload to keep preset/live state aligned

Code refs:
- @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/SettingsScreen.kt#3294-3314

### Planner Response

Implemented a focused root-cause fix: **[SettingsScreen](file:///c:/Users/javie/AndroidStudioProjects/TeXter2025/app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/SettingsScreen.kt:150:0-847:1) was dropping transform state before it reached [ColorsSection](file:///c:/Users/javie/AndroidStudioProjects/TeXter2025/app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/SettingsScreen.kt:1338:0-2460:1)**, so downstream editors got default values (`0f/0f/1f/0f`) even when [MainActivity](file:///c:/Users/javie/AndroidStudioProjects/TeXter2025/app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/MainActivity.kt:52:0-4397:1) had real rotation/offset/scale.

### What I changed

- Updated `SettingsScreen -> ColorsSection(...)` call to pass **all missing transform args** for every section (custom bg, content, memo, file list item, file list background), including rotation.
- This prevents fallback defaults in [ColorPresetRow](file:///c:/Users/javie/AndroidStudioProjects/TeXter2025/app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/SettingsScreen.kt:2510:0-3370:1) / [UnifiedBackgroundEditor](file:///c:/Users/javie/AndroidStudioProjects/TeXter2025/app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/UnifiedBackgroundEditor.kt:23:0-538:1).

**Code change:**  
- @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/SettingsScreen.kt#632-666

### Planner Response

Fixed another root cause from your logs.

### What I changed
When you tap an **existing photo square** in Settings, the code restored URI + offset + scale, but **did not restore rotation**.  
So the app could look like “same issue” even though values were partly updating.

I added rotation restore in that selection path:

- `onBackgroundPhotoRotationChange?.invoke(preset.photoRotation)`  
  @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/SettingsScreen.kt#2849-2853

Also made plain-color selection fully reset transform state (offset/scale/rotation), so there’s no stale carryover:

- reset to `offsetX=0f`, `offsetY=0f`, `scale=1f`, `rotation=0f`  
  @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/SettingsScreen.kt#2854-2861

### Validation
- ✅ `./gradlew.bat :app:compileDebugKotlin` passed.

### Plain-language checkpoint
- **Problem:** choosing an existing photo preset was not reapplying its saved twist angle.
- **What was done:** I wired that missing twist restore on selection.
- **Current status:** build is successful; this should now make selected photo squares keep their rotation in the editor path too.

### Docs updated
- @CHANGELOG.md#13-35  
- @CHAT_HISTORY.md#3-23

I followed your saved preference memory to include this short normal-language checkpoint alongside technical details.

### Fix applied

I found the remaining root cause and patched it.

The rotation values were being saved correctly in [MainActivity](file:///c:/Users/javie/AndroidStudioProjects/TeXter2025/app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/MainActivity.kt:52:0-4400:1) callbacks, but they were **not forwarded** in one key path: `Settings -> FileManagementApp(...)`.  
Because [FileManagementApp](file:///c:/Users/javie/AndroidStudioProjects/TeXter2025/app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/MainActivity.kt:4402:0-4748:1) has default rotation params (`0f`), [FullScreenEditor](file:///c:/Users/javie/AndroidStudioProjects/TeXter2025/app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/FullScreenEditor.kt:58:0-966:1) ended up receiving default rotation in that flow.

I added the missing forwards in:

- `customBgPhotoRotation = customBgPhotoRotation`
- `contentAreaPhotoRotation = contentAreaPhotoRotation`
- `memoAreaPhotoRotation = memoAreaPhotoRotation`

at @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/MainActivity.kt#3904-3924

---

### Why this fixes your issue

Previously, even after twist was detected/saved, the file-open path could still reset to default rotation due to missing arg forwarding.  
Now, the saved non-zero rotation actually reaches [FileManagementApp](file:///c:/Users/javie/AndroidStudioProjects/TeXter2025/app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/MainActivity.kt:4402:0-4748:1) and then [FullScreenEditor](file:///c:/Users/javie/AndroidStudioProjects/TeXter2025/app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/FullScreenEditor.kt:58:0-966:1).

### What I changed

In the cross-section preview path (`UnifiedBackgroundEditor -> PreviewTouchArea -> AppLayoutPreview`), non-active sections were missing rotation data.

I patched [UnifiedBackgroundEditor.kt](file:///c:/Users/javie/AndroidStudioProjects/TeXter2025/app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/UnifiedBackgroundEditor.kt:0:0-0:0) to:

1. **Load rotation for all sections** from SharedPreferences  
   (`custom/content/memo/fileListItem/fileListBg`).
2. **Store them in local loaded state vars**.
3. **Pass them through [PreviewTouchArea(...)](file:///c:/Users/javie/AndroidStudioProjects/TeXter2025/app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/UnifiedBackgroundEditor.kt:637:0-837:1)**.
4. **Forward them into `AppLayoutPreview(...)`** via:
   - `customBgPhotoRotation`
   - `contentAreaPhotoRotation`
   - `memoAreaPhotoRotation`
   - `fileListItemPhotoRotation`
   - `fileListBgPhotoRotation`
